The weight of potatoes grown in a particular state is normally distributed. A farmer sampled $100$ potatoes from his field and found that the sample standard deviation of weights is $1.5oz$.
Find a $90%$ confidence interval for the population standard deviation in the entire state.

*Hint: Given a random variable $X$ that has a chi-square distribution $χ^{2}(ν)$ with $ν$ degrees of freedom, the table below shows the values $χ_{ν, p}$ such that $P(X > χ_{ν, p}) = p$ for some particular values of $ν$ and $p$.*

| $ν∖p$ | $0.995$ | $0.975$ | $0.950$ | $0.050$ | $0.025$ | $0.005$ |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| $99$ | $66.510$ | $73.361$ | $77.046$ | $123.225$ | $128.422$ | $138.987$ |
| $100$ | $67.328$ | $74.222$ | $77.929$ | $124.342$ | $129.561$ | $140.169$ |
| $101$ | $68.146$ | $75.083$ | $78.813$ | $125.458$ | $130.700$ | $141.351$ |

> A scientific calculator is required to answer this question.
